_comment: Known-violations ratchet, not an exemption list. Each count is the number of dead-code findings fallow reported on 2026-10-21 that are banked in .fallowrc.json (unusedFiles, unusedExports) or behind an inline `fallow-ignore-next-line circular-dependency` marker (circularDependencies). Anything NOT in these counts fails FALLOW-1..4 in test/scaffold-conformity.test.ts, so the suite is green on the banked population and red on everything new. Lowering a number means deleting the matching suppression in the same commit; test/fallow-baseline.test.ts refuses a change to either side alone.
measuredWith: fallow 3.34.1 — `fallow dead-code --format json` with .fallowrc.json entry points applied
